messages:
Lia (SupplyOps): Quick heads-up — carrier flagged a partial return on the last H100 shipment, wants to consolidate diagnostics into a single RMA to save us brokerage. Need buy-in on insurance sublimit and customs HS classification.
Matt (Logistics): Which AWBs? I can ask SkyFreight to merge if weight/volume ok.
Lia (SupplyOps): AWB list:
```
MAWB: 987-6543210
AWB: 123-4567890, 123-4567891
Carrier: SkyFreight Express
Estimated return ETA: 2026-04-02
```
Matt (Logistics): OK saw those. Carrier requests us to accept a single MAWB consolidation. They quoted +$420 brokerage vs $1.2k separate — seems worth it. Need confirmation on declared value for insurance (they propose $250k total).
Ana (Procurement): Can we accept $250k? That’s under our normal declared value for H100s, but accounting needs the invoice reference. I can push for vendor credit on brokerage if they mis-shipped.
Jules (Infra): For context — these units are earmarked for eu-west-1 capacity pool. If consolidation delays customs more than 24h we risk a region provisioning gap next week. Any ETA impact?
Matt (Logistics): Carrier says consolidation adds one business day at forwarder hub. Customs clearance unaffected provided HS code is correct.
Lia (SupplyOps): HS code proposed by vendor: 8471.50.90 — looks generic. Ops: do we want to reclassify to avoid hold? 
Jules (Infra): 8471 is fine but double-check duties in FRA vs AMS. We have a tight thermal window for these units if they sit >72h. Request expedited customs lane if weight > 300kg.
Ana (Procurement): I'll ask vendor for a credit for brokerage and confirm invoice lines. Lia, can you open an internal ticket so finance has a reference?
Lia (SupplyOps): Created ticket INC-2026-78 and added vendor PO + photos: <https://redwood.internal/ticket/INC-2026-78> 
ops-bot: RMA created: RMA-4598. Labels pending. Attach manifest to RMA when ready.
Matt (Logistics): I'll push SkyFreight to waive brokerage or reduce to $150. If they hold firm we still save $$ vs separate AWBs. I'll attach the consolidation manifest here when I get it.
Logistics-Bot: Manifest uploaded to RMA-4598 (3 files). Link: https://files.redwood/cases/RMA-4598/manifest.zip
Jules (Infra): Can we route replacements from our eu spare pool if this slips? I want a contingency path — preferring crossdock from DE spare to FR cluster. Ana, can procurement approve swap from spare inventory if needed?
Ana (Procurement): Yes, we have 4 spares in DE pool. I can greenlight a temporary transfer as long as we record vendor credit for the return.
Lia (SupplyOps): Action items:
- Matt: finalize consolidation with SkyFreight and push brokerage credit (ETA today EOD).
- Ana: confirm vendor credit terms on invoice and declared value.
- Jules: confirm crossdock routing and thermal hold threshold for spare swap.
- Lia: attach photos + ticket to RMA, monitor customs window.
Matt (Logistics): On it. Will update thread with AWB merge confirmation and final brokerage number. :thumbsup:
Jules (Infra): If we hit >24h delay, I’ll trigger the spare swap and notify oncall.
Ana (Procurement): Will follow up with vendor now.
Lia (SupplyOps): Thanks — ping me if carrier asks for any additional paperwork.
Matt (Logistics): Quick PS — if SkyFreight insists on separate paperwork per AWB we should still ask for consolidated house manifest to speed customs. I’ll request that now.
Lia (SupplyOps): noted. Closing loop once manifest posted. :white_check_mark:
